title: Manikyakallu
overview: Vinayachandran, a young teacher arrives at a failing village school determined to transform it. Through patience and empathy, he inspires his disheartened students and colleagues, turning the neglected institution into a place of hope, learning and second chances.

songs.title: Manikyakallu
songs.singers: Faisal Ponnani, Riyas Vizhinjam, Rashmi Panikar, Sibu Sukumaran
